text: The 2021 tree-cover loss within the pine plantation asset was approximately 81.3 hectares. This loss is corroborated by multiple sources, with 98% of the event area agreed upon by the JRC 2020 reference. The asset, covering 3643.5 hectares, is identified as a planted forest with no native forest present. The loss occurred within the planted forest area, specifically involving Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species. Therefore, all of the 2021 loss was indeed inside the pine plantation.
